newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian general makes suicide leap in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Russian general makes suicide leap in Moscow.

text.p: A 49-year-old Russian general leapt to his death from a window of his 15th floor apartment in Moscow, Interfax news agency quoted police as saying on Tuesday.

Major-General Viktor Shipilov left no note but police were treating the death as suicide. Low morale and poor living conditions have prompted a spate of suicides in Russia's military ranks, but mainly among poorly paid conscripts and junior officers.

Shipilov, whose apartment was in one of the capital's privileged suburbs, was air attache to Yugoslavia until 1996. He had not occupied any position since and was undergoing medical treatment, Interfax said.
Killings by ill-treated or underfed army conscripts have also become not uncommon.

Police in the far eastern Birobidzhan region arrested a border guard who abandoned his post on Tuesday and went berserk with a machine gun. He was arrested after he killed two civilians and stole their car.
